archetype: Archetype 2 (The Performance Pro) - Modified for Sports & Crypto FOMO

layout.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-4 for dense widgets, p-8 to p-12 for major containers.
layout.border_radius: rounded-none to rounded-sm (max 4px). Sharp, athletic feel.
layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dashboard) + Massive Hero Section. Mobile-first grid-cols-1, md:grid-cols-12. Center 8 cols for Timer/Pot, side 4 cols for feeds/actions.

components.surfaces: Tactical Minimalism. No soft drop shadows. Use 1px solid borders (`border-border_color`). Add 2px inner highlights (`shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]`) for depth.
components.hero_timer: Massive 7-segment or bold sans-serif numbers. When > 60s, it's White/Green glow. When < 60s, transitions to Danger Red, pulsing scale animation.
components.buttons: Heavy, physical feel. 'Shoot' button should be massive, Turf Green or Penalty Red, with a hover effect that deepens the color and intensifies the drop-shadow/glow.
components.live_feed: Scrolling timeline container. Use a subtle gradient 'tracing beam' on the left border to indicate live incoming data.
components.glassmorphism: Avoid muddy glass. Use `bg-surface_main/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border_highlight` for sticky headers or bottom action bars.
components.admin_panel: Strictly functional, high contrast, clean grid. Separate visual mode (no stadium background, just dark slate `#0F172A` to differentiate from the public game).

images.description: Dark stadium background. MUST use a heavy dark overlay (`bg-background_base/80` or `/90`) so it provides texture without ruining text contrast.
3D Crypto Football. Place near the Pot Size indicator, floating gently with CSS animation (translate-y).

features: Manual shoot button (Connect wallet, fire shot)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for pulsing/scrolling.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements, buttons, and form inputs MUST include `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Bebas Neue, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Avoid generic DeFi purple/cyan. Stick STRICTLY to the World Cup Red/Green turf palette.
Build the dashboard to feel like a live sports scoreboard - high tension, high urgency.
For the bilingual rules section, use Shadcn Tabs to toggle between ZH and EN.
Use Shadcn UI for complex components but strip 'Vercel-like' styles. Replace with sharp, athletic 1px bordered boxes.
Ensure the layout is highly responsive. The Timer and Pot MUST be immediately visible above the fold on mobile.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide for UI iconography (e.g., wallet, timer, bot, history).
